## Quality education doesn't wait for the right address.

Meghshala is Megh Foundation's volunteer-powered teaching program that sends trained volunteers directly into slum communities and underprivileged areas to teach children.

Our volunteers don't just teach - they build relationships, spark curiosity, restore confidence, and show every child that someone cares enough to show up.

## What Meghshala volunteers teach

- Basic literacy and numeracy
- English language fundamentals
- Digital literacy and basic computer skills
- Life skills: hygiene, communication, confidence
- Creative activities: drawing, storytelling, art
- Value education: respect, empathy, teamwork

## Who Meghshala serves

Children aged 5-15 years in slum communities and underprivileged neighborhoods with limited access to quality school education.

## What makes Meghshala different

We go to them. We don't wait for children to come to us. Volunteers travel to communities, removing barriers between a child and quality learning.

## Volunteer call

If you are a student, teacher, professional, or anyone with a love for learning and children, Meghshala needs you. Even 2 hours a week can change a child's life.
